cheapest_decisive_test.action: scripts/screen_batch.py --batch t20261001_01_dash_for_cash --iteration t20261001_01_dash_for_cash_settlement on local SPY daily bars (DFC_U, DFC_C, two fixed-tau-4 controls, E0_REF reproduction), then scripts/run_t20261001_01_dfc_placebo.py (100-seed random-entry placebo, SPY day-position profile by settlement era, pre/post window correlation, approximate 50/50 blends with S0). Separately T-20261001-02 measures M1-M3 on P500 12-1 momentum losers.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: DFC_U or DFC_C (era-aligned only) passes the four-part replacement rule against E0 (select 10 bp Sharpe >= 1.439; 2026 contaminated Sharpe >= -0.674; select 20 bp Sharpe >= 1.271; stress Sharpe >= 0.584) with placebo beat >= 0.90 in select and stress, or passes K1 (anchor >= 1.19 and stress >= 0.65 at 10 bp, 20 bp CAGR > 0 in both) or K2 (S3 edge >= +0.05 in anchor and stress) with placebo beat >= 0.90 in anchor and stress.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: Both era-aligned candidates fail the replacement rule, K1 and K2 (or fail the placebo where they pass) -> the index-level settlement-timed window is closed and E0 stays. If T-20261001-02 also fails M1 (no PreTOM loser underperformance in 2016-2026 P500 data, NW t > -2), the dash-for-cash line is closed for this repository.

cost_and_execution_assumptions: Frozen contract: signal at the close, fill at the next open, 10 bp per side judged and 20 bp per side stress; long-only SPY, cash otherwise (same cash convention as E0 in screen_batch). About 12 round trips a year for DFC_U (2.4%/yr at 10 bp). Real SPY spread is about 0.3 bp, so the frozen cost is conservative by design; the frozen numbers decide.
existing_solution_comparison: Existing local work: TOM_SPY (close tau -> close tau+4, H-20260928-05) refuted at anchor Sharpe -0.69 / stress -0.10; E0 (4th Friday -> month end < 0 -> hold next month) is the C2 E leg at select 1.34 / anchor 1.24 / stress 0.58 / 2026 -0.57, and its 7 variants (E1-E7, H-20260928-20) all enter at the month-end close; sectoral intramonth momentum (T-20260929-37) is a different high-turnover composite. None tests the pre-month-end window after the settlement-implied cash-raising day or the 2024 T+1 boundary shift. Public evidence: Etula et al. 2020 (US to 2013, T+3) and Nathan et al. 2026 (to 2025, T+1 DiD +85.9 bp, t 2.68); Quantseeker (practitioner) finds [0,+3] dead after 2015 and [-3,+3] alive but weakening. No public live record of a settlement-timed index rule was found. Reuse: screen_batch/screen_lane engine, E0 and S0 builders and returns; nothing new is built beyond the date logic. Practitioner evidence (Quantseeker, Hull Tactical) and the E0 sources (Graziani 2024, Harbourfront) are listed in external-brief.json, not here, because direction-check accepts only primary sources opened this round.

remaining_evidence_gap: Whether the post-reform shift persists in 2026 (outside Nathan et al.'s sample; 9 month-ends) and whether any index-level window pays after 10 bp per side; the mid-month payday and dividend-payment flows are not tested.

sources.claim: Etula, Rinne, Suominen, Vaittinen (RFS 2020, 33(1):75-111): institutions raise cash for month-end payments by selling equities until the settlement-implied deadline (T-4 under T+3, T = last trading day). US CRSP VW return 1995-2013: -17 bp over T-8..T-4 and +77 bp over T-3..T+3 (abnormal -37 / +48 bp); corr(T-3..T-1, T-8..T-4) = -0.54 in 2003-2013; 22 of 25 markets show significant reversals; the 2014 European T+3->T+2 change moved the reversal closer to month end (DiD -0.776, t -3.70).

sources.independent_replication: Nathan, Suominen and Tasa (2026) extend the sample to 2025 and add the 2024 US T+1 reform (shares an author, Suominen). Quantseeker (practitioner, read via summarizer only) finds the [-3,+3] ETF window still significant after 2015 but declining, and [0,+3] insignificant.

stop_condition: Close the index window if DFC_U and DFC_C fail the replacement rule, K1 and K2; close the whole dash-for-cash line if T-20261001-02 also fails M1. A pass of the replacement rule is a proposal to the owner (C2 runs on paper under a frozen rule), never an automatic swap.
target_regime_and_horizon: US large-cap index (SPY), a 6-7 trading-day window around month end; regime = the current T+1 settlement era from 2024-05-28, with the stress window 2016-05..2023-09 under T+3/T+2 for the pre-reform boundary.
